purpose: Recognizable distribution marks beside OS names in the installer dropdown; descriptive identification, no affiliation asserted.
asset_integrity: Source hashes refer to downloaded originals; deployed hashes cover metadata cleanup, viewBox normalization and published brand fills listed per asset. Raspberry Pi PNG is unchanged.

assets.name: Debian
assets.copyright: Copyright 1999 Software in the Public Interest, Inc.; design Raul Silva.
assets.notes: Open-use swirl without wordmark. Keep original red; a light backing improves dark-surface contrast. Debian requests linking logo to debian.org.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: Ubuntu
assets.notes: Official Ubuntu community Circle of Friends round sticker SVG linked from Canonical's Ubuntu Discourse. Original orange and white, no wordmark. No separate open-source asset license established.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: Linux Mint
assets.notes: Official green ring mark; reference repository publishes logo alternatives. No explicit asset license found in inspected README.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: Raspberry Pi OS
assets.notes: Official full-color registered Raspberry Pi mark. Current rules were updated June 17, 2026; rules restrict logo use to genuine products/services and require an applicable website logo to link to raspberrypi.com. This is the company mark used to identify Raspberry Pi OS, not an invented OS-specific logo. Original PNG has transparent padding; 591×592 canvas and visible bounding box [146,104,519,488]. A light backing preserves black outlines on dark surfaces.

assets.name: Fedora
assets.copyright_license: Custom Fedora logo terms; Simple Icons metadata explicitly identifies custom licensing for this mark.
assets.notes: Official white-and-blue mark; the two original paths and colors are unchanged. The wordmark is excluded using the standalone mark bounds.
modifications: Extracted the two original mark paths without changing their geometry or colors; fitted viewBox to standalone mark.

assets.name: Rocky Linux
assets.notes: Original green logomark. RESF policy prohibits altered mark/colors or endorsement implications. README's CC-BY-4.0 statement applies to policy text, not an inferred separate license for the logo.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: AlmaLinux
assets.notes: Official color icon without wordmark. Preserve colors/proportions. Official SVG has large Adobe metadata/foreignObject blocks (~793 KB); remove only nonvisual editor metadata before deployment if desired. Do not claim the trademark policy text's CC license applies to logo art.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: CentOS
assets.notes: Current official site's small-size favicon SVG: multicolor CentOS mark in a purple circle. Copyright license not established; trademark guidelines apply.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: Arch Linux
assets.copyright_license: Simple Icons distribution CC0-1.0; Arch trademark rights remain separate.
assets.notes: Simple Icons mark-only fallback traced to Arch's official artwork page. Official press SVGs on that page include wordmark. Use published blue with unchanged paths.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: Manjaro
assets.notes: Official site logo, original teal. No explicit asset copyright license or brand guidance established. SVG has width/height but no viewBox; preserve scaling or add equivalent 0 0 100.61127 100.61127 viewBox without changing paths.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.
Added equivalent viewBox for proportional scaling.

assets.name: EndeavourOS
assets.copyright_license: Official branding repository contains GPL-3.0 LICENSE; trademarks remain separate.
assets.notes: Original multicolor mark only; use this filename rather than endeavouros.svg in staging, which is a different upstream variant with tiny wordmark. LICENSE copy is endeavouros-LICENSE.txt.
modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: CachyOS

modifications: Removed nonvisual editor metadata and comments; visible paths/colors preserved.

assets.name: openSUSE
